name: star-reach
$comment-enet: ENet is deferred (architecture.md Law 9). Add it here when net/ un-defers, together with the sr_net CMake target.
$comment-glfw3: Not used directly, and already a transitive dependency of raylib. Declared explicitly because CMakeLists.txt has to link it by hand on static triplets: raylib is built with USE_EXTERNAL_GLFW=ON but never exports glfw in its link interface, so libraylib.a ships undefined glfw* symbols. See the comment above find_package(glfw3) for why the condition is static-vs-shared rather than per-OS.
$comment-raylib-pin: Pinned below 6.0 deliberately -- vcpkg's raylib port added -DCUSTOMIZE_BUILD=ON when it updated to 6.0 (vcpkg commit e8c2ec9120), which has a config.h-parsing bug that silently enables SUPPORT_CUSTOM_FRAME_CONTROL, making EndDrawing() a no-op for buffer swap/event poll: the app runs (CPU ticks, no crash) but the window never presents a frame and never processes input. Confirmed against a from-scratch minimal raylib program, independent of anything in this codebase -- not a driver/GPU/linkage issue. Tracked upstream at https://github.com/microsoft/vcpkg/issues/51576; a fix exists on raylib's master branch but is not yet in a tagged release, and vcpkg's port has not adopted it. Re-evaluate un-pinning once that issue closes.
